relationships.subject: Propofol
relationships.evidence_quote: In the propofol group animals, the expressions of EPAC1 were inhibited, but not EPAC2.

relationships.subject: Propofol
relationships.evidence_quote: it inhibits the GluN2B-p38MAP K/EPAC pathway in the dorsal horn region of the spinal cord

relationships.subject: Propofol
relationships.evidence_quote: A suppression of phosphorylated GluN2B was observed after 1 hour in the propofol group in the ipsilateral L4-L6 dorsal horn.

relationships.subject: Propofol
relationships.evidence_quote: Pain was significantly less in the group receiving propofol when compared with the isoflurane group for the first two hours of injury.

key_findings: Propofol suppressed spinal dorsal horn EPAC1 (not EPAC2), phospho-GluN2B and p38 MAPK after sciatic nerve ligation injury in rats.
Propofol reduced early mechanical allodynia relative to isoflurane.
